scope: Historical findings from the 2026-10-23 command audit; issue and PR links do not change sealed observations.

findings.invariant: Parser failures in agent mode have one structured usage error.

oracle.expected: exit 2; empty stdout; one JSON USAGE_ERROR on stderr; zero REST and target requests

actual.transcript: quality/command-audit/observations-crosscutting.json: exit 2 with human Typer Usage/Error on stderr

issue.title: Agent-mode parser failures emit human Usage instead of JSON

findings.invariant: Local command preflight errors in agent mode have one structured usage error before effects.

reproduction.command: BP_AGENT=1 bp check idor http://127.0.0.1:<owned-fixture>/item/{id} --param id --own 1 --target 2 --header broken

oracle.expected: exit 2; empty stdout; one JSON USAGE_ERROR on stderr; zero REST and target requests

actual.transcript: quality/command-audit/observations-checks.json: plaintext local usage error on stderr

effects.evidence: quality/command-audit/observations-checks.json: local refusal before REST or target request

issue.title: Agent-mode command preflight and notes break JSON stderr contract

findings.invariant: Fuzz payload preflight errors in agent mode are structured and produce no effects.

oracle.expected: exit 2; empty stdout; one JSON USAGE_ERROR on stderr; no fuzz run, REST or target effect

issue.title: Agent-mode command preflight and notes break JSON stderr contract

findings.invariant: A replay response preserves post-send persistence failure and no-retry guidance.

reproduction.command: POST /history/{id}/replay with one mocked Montoya send and injected H2 persistence failure

oracle.expected: HTTP 200 with persistence.status=FAILED and do-not-retry warning; exactly one send

actual.transcript: RED HistoryReplayPersistenceTest: HTTP 200, data.persistence absent after one send

effects.evidence: RED route test in issue #4 and PR #10: one mocked send, one failed H2 write; no real target claim

issue.title: History replay response drops persistence failure after a successful send

findings.invariant: Every dependency version permitted by wheel metadata can launch the CLI on supported Python 3.11.

reproduction.command: Python 3.11 fresh wheel install with typer==0.12.0 and click==8.1.8, then bp --help

oracle.expected: resolver-valid install displays help and exits 0

actual.transcript: RuntimeError: Type not yet supported: str | None before command dispatch

effects.evidence: local fresh wheel smoke in issue #6: no REST, ledger or target effect

issue.title: Package metadata permits Typer versions that cannot start bp

findings.assumption: Bare bp history dispatches to history list.
findings.observation: bp history exits 2 with group help and no REST; bp history list calls GET /history. The public docs only promise the explicit list form.

integrationLimit: S3.1 proxy capture was not executed in an isolated licensed Burp profile; 49 of 50 ordered actions were observed, and no external target effect is claimed.
